sheet-2.description: The western edge of the Peetzburg section of New Milford, Bergen County, along the boundary with the Borough of Oradell, drawn at 50 feet to an inch. The sheet covers the blocks between Harrison, Grand, Center and Fulton (River) Streets, from Golden Gate Avenue, on which the borough limits run, east to Pershing and Washington (Madison) Avenues. The Borough of Oradell is lettered along the top and left margins; St. Joseph's R.C. Church and its rectory, on the Oradell side of the line at Grand Street, are drawn with the note that they are also shown on the Oradell map. North of Center Street the blocks are long and narrow, partly built up with frame dwellings along Harrison Street and Grand Street; the Hotel Center with its bowling alleys stands on the north side of Center Street. South of Center Street three blocks between Golden Gate, California, Pine and Washington Avenues hold dwellings, a store building at the Center and Golden Gate corner, the Wesley M.E. Church on California Avenue and the Washington Public School on Washington Avenue. Six inch water pipes are drawn along every street, with fire hydrants and a fire alarm box marked. The top margin is marked no exposure, and the sheet continues on sheet 3 to the east and sheet 5 to the south.
notes: Harrison, Grand, Center and Fulton are printed without a suffix; today they are Harrison Street, Grand Street, Center Street and Fulton Street.
Fulton is also labelled River; Washington Avenue is also labelled Madison Avenue.
Pershing Avenue is drawn a few feet west of the line of Washington Avenue; in OpenStreetMap the two are one straight line.
Buildings of note: St. Joseph's R.C. Church and rectory (Oradell side), Hotel Center with bowling alleys, Wesley M.E. Church, Washington Public School.

Scale 50 ft. West edge of the Peetzburg section on the Oradell line: Harrison, Grand, Center, Fulton (River) from Golden Gate Av to Pershing / Washington (Madison) Av. One part. St. Joseph's R.C. Church on the Oradell side ('also shown on Oradell map').

sheet-3.description: The middle of the Peetzburg section of New Milford, Bergen County, drawn at 50 feet to an inch, with the Borough of Oradell lettered along the top margin and the borough limits running across the top of the sheet. It covers the blocks from Pershing Avenue and Washington (Madison) Avenue on the west to Prospect Avenue on the east, and from Harrison, which angles up towards River Road at the north, south through Grand and Center to Fulton (River) at the bottom. River Road (Grove Avenue) runs down the middle of the sheet. The northern blocks, between the borough line, Harrison and Grand, are long narrow building lots, most of them still empty, with a few frame dwellings near River Road; the block east of River Road between the borough line and Grand is more built up. South of Grand the blocks are a mix of dwellings and outbuildings, with a store building on the west side of River Road between Grand and Center. The three blocks south of Center, between Washington, Lenox, River Road and Prospect, are platted in narrow lots with scattered dwellings, a few stores and a workshop. Six inch water pipes and fire hydrants are drawn in every street. The top margin is marked no exposure; the sheet adjoins sheet 2 on the west, sheet 4 on the east and sheet 5 on the south.
notes: Harrison, Grand, Center and Fulton are printed without a suffix; today they are Harrison Street, Grand Street, Center Street and Fulton Street.
River Road is also labelled Grove Avenue, Washington Avenue also Madison Avenue, Fulton also River.
Harrison is drawn straight to River Road; today Harrison Street curves at its east end, and the drawn Harrison / Pershing junction is about 3.5 m from the modern one (left out of the control).
Scale 50 ft. Pershing / Washington (Madison) Av to Prospect Av, borough line to Fulton (River); River Rd (Grove Av) down the middle. One part.

sheet-4.description: The eastern part of the Peetzburg section of New Milford, Bergen County, drawn at 50 feet to an inch, along the line with the Borough of Oradell, which is lettered across the top margin above the borough limits. The sheet covers the blocks between Prospect, Summit and Eagle Avenues and the Boulevard, which runs along the north edge and then angles down the east side of the sheet, from the borough line south through Grand and Center to Fulton (River) at the bottom. North of Grand the blocks are deep narrow lots with frame dwellings scattered along them. Between Grand and Center stand the Town Hall with Fire Dept. Hose Co. No. 1 and a fire alarm, a bottling works on Eagle Avenue near the Boulevard, and a paint shop; south of Center are the Lutheran Church on Summit Avenue, stores and storage buildings, and a concrete club house near the Boulevard. East of the Boulevard a few dwellings and storage buildings are drawn in block 204 and along the top margin. Six inch water pipes run in each street. The sheet adjoins sheet 3 on the west and sheets 5 and 6 on the south.
notes: Grand, Center and Fulton are printed without a suffix; today they are Grand Street, Center Street and Fulton Street. Fulton is also labelled River.
Eagle Avenue north of Grand is drawn straight; today it curves north-east to meet the Boulevard.
Buildings of note: Town Hall with Fire Dept. Hose Co. No. 1, Lutheran Church, a bottling works, a club house.
Scale 50 ft. Prospect, Summit, Eagle Avs to the Boulevard, borough line to Fulton (River). Town Hall, bottling works, Lutheran church. One part.

sheet-5.description: The southern part of the Peetzburg section of New Milford, Bergen County, and the Hackensack River on its west side, drawn at 100 feet to an inch. The Hackensack River winds down the left half of the sheet with the borough limits and the Borough of Oradell lettered beyond it. Madison Avenue (River Road) runs diagonally along the west side past the property of the Hackensack Water Co., where water mains, a supply shed and supply yard are drawn, and New Milford Avenue crosses it at the upper left. East of the river the sheet covers the blocks from Golden Gate, California and Pine Avenues across to Washington (Madison), Lenox, River Road (Grove Avenue), Prospect and Summit Avenues, between Fulton (River) at the top and Cleveland (South Blvd.), Main, Demarest Avenue and Milford Avenue further south. A brook crosses the blocks between Pine Avenue and Summit Avenue. The northern blocks are long rows of narrow lots with scattered dwellings and a storage building; the blocks south of Cleveland are more built up, with stores and the post office near River Road and Main. A diagonal Washington Avenue (Madison Avenue) runs south-west from Main across the large open block 42. In the lower right, Old Road (Union Avenue), Park, Grove and Salem Street bound block 49. Six inch water pipes run in most streets. The sheet adjoins sheets 2, 3 and 4 on the north and sheets 6 and 7 on the east and south.
notes: Fulton, Cleveland and Main are printed without a suffix; today they are Fulton Street, Cleveland Street and Main Street. Cleveland is also labelled South Blvd., Fulton also River, River Road also Grove Avenue, Washington Avenue also Madison Avenue, and the diagonal Madison Avenue at the west also River Road.
The diagonal Washington Avenue (Madison Avenue) between Main and Madison Avenue no longer exists.
Old Road (Union Avenue) and Park are not in OpenStreetMap under those names; Grove is Grove Street today.
Property of the Hackensack Water Co. with a supply shed and supply yard lies along Madison Avenue by the river.
Scale 100 ft. Southern Peetzburg and the Hackensack River: Fulton to Milford Av, Golden Gate Av to Summit / Grove; Madison Av (River Rd) and Hackensack Water Co. property at the west. One part.
